sentence: This project develops boron-containing antibiotics that target four parts of the protein synthesis machinery in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
This project builds and tests a peer-led social media intervention to reduce non-medical use of prescription opioids in young adults.
This project uses genetic approaches to work out what genes and proteins do and to predict susceptibility to disease.
This project studies how age-related mitochondrial damage releases double-stranded RNA that triggers inflammation in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia.
This project builds an imaging technique that goes past the ultrasound diffraction limit to see microstructures in deep tissue noninvasively.
This project develops a method for profiling serum antibodies and builds machine learning models to diagnose Systemic Lupus Erythematosus from a single blood draw.
This project tries to find out which combination of immune responses caused by the vaccine protects children against malaria.
This project studies how ferroptosis resistance leads to acquired radioresistance in lung and esophageal cancers.
This project examines how a specific genetic mutation disrupts cellular processes in muscle development and tests whether adenine base editing can fix it.
This project tests methods that use computer analyses of video recordings of patients to measure treatment impact in blepharospasm.
This project builds tools for genetic research on aging, behavioral, and social phenotypes that account for differences between populations.
This project studies how complement and coagulation crosstalk contributes to thrombosis in myeloproliferative neoplasms, using assays, microfluidics models and mouse models.
This project engineers systems of chimeric antigen receptor T cells, natural killer cells, and macrophages to find receptor combinations that help them work together.
This project develops a method to give gene therapy to isolated rat, pig, and human lung grafts to prevent alloimmune injury.
This project studies how a histone methyltransferase that is overexpressed in metastatic cancers primes an immunosuppressive metastatic niche.
This project adds features, including natural language processing, to a search engine for electronic medical records used in cancer research.
This project develops ways to detect pancreatic cancer early by combining human-expert knowledge with deep neural networks that use electronic health records.
This project investigates how workplace policies and organizational structures affect the well-being of staff in community-based overdose prevention programs.
This project gives researchers access to cell sorting, flow cytometry and omics technologies to study obesity, cardiorenal and metabolic diseases.
